memo.objective: To assess whether purchasing followed the value bands in the Rules [rule:CPR-02], starting from {{pack.risks_in_scope}} risks the auditor placed in scope.
memo.scope: Spend in the {{$.population.months_covered}} months analysed; {{pack.tests}} tests on {{pack.sample_transactions}} transactions.
memo.approach: Each flagged item is traced to the council's own records before any conclusion is drawn.
memo.limitations: Flags are indicators only; payments below the publication floor are not visible.

controls.control: Related purchases are aggregated before the value band is chosen.
Three invitations to quote are issued at or above the publication value.

tests.step: For each sampled window, obtain the orders and quotation record and confirm how the value band was decided [rule:CPR-01] [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold['25000.00'].headline_general_procurement.windows].
For each sampled group, obtain the invoices and confirm each payment was separately due [rule:CPR-03] [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.headline_general_procurement.groups].

pbc.request: Quotation records and purchase orders for the suppliers and dates in the sample.

rules_not_tested.reason: Sealing of contracts is outside the approved risks.
